relationships.subject: BIBN4096
relationships.evidence_quote: while the highest dose of 5 mg/kg of BIBN4096 fully reversed paclitaxel-induced mechanical hypersensitivity at 3 h post injection

key_findings: Paclitaxel upregulates spinal Calcrl/Ramp1 with increased MLL2 binding and H3K4me2 at the Calcrl promoter, while CGRP expression is unchanged.
CGRP receptor antagonist BIBN4096 reverses paclitaxel-induced mechanical and cold hypersensitivity.
